_comment: Version transitions the eval scores. Chosen 2026-07-21 to span small->large codebase and quiet->big-feature. Each run humanifies input(to) with prior=humanified(from).
_paths: Override per-host with --inputs-base / --priors-base. The bahadur devcontainer mirrors these exact paths, so they resolve there unchanged. The LLM endpoint is deliberately NOT here (this repo is public): pass --endpoint, or set llm.endpoint in the git-ignored .humanify.local.json at the repo root (experiments/lib/llm-endpoint.sh).
_libraryIndex: The library index a names-mode launch reads (names is the binary's default since exp171): the full prebuilt Bun index (exp152, names tables exp159; re-fingerprinted under match-key/5 by exp204 --replay, 4736dcfa, adopted 2026-11-09). Override with --library-index; refused with --pipeline-set library.matching=off.

pairs.kind: bundler restyle (~130 vendor modules re-minified, source unchanged)
